text: This report provides information on property tax accounts with outstanding receivables of $500,000 or more as of June 30, 2020. For property tax accounts owned by identifiable individuals, the information is provided in a confidential attachment (Confidential Attachment 3).
The General Government and Licensing Committee: 1. Directed that Confidential Attachment 3 to the report (August 28, 2020) from the Controller remain confidential in its entirety.
